NAM.note: The page lists data-integration MoUs with GIPF, SSC, the tax system, IFMS and the Veteran Affairs System; none is with a national ID.

facts.fact: The Ministry's activity page lists MoUs for data integration with GIPF, SSC, the tax system, IFMS and the Veteran Affairs System, and the integration of the ISAS module into the Integrated Beneficiary Registry, and gives the activity as Complete with the system piloted by June 2022.
The page says a central information management system was developed holding all social grant beneficiaries, to remove duplication, with the activity at 100 percent and Complete.
